name: unofficial-zaptec-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for Zaptec EV chargers: status, history with optional cost, pause/resume, available current. Not affiliated with Zaptec AS.

tools.name: zaptec_get_status
tools.description: Current charger snapshot: operating mode, power, session energy, phases, diagnostics, available current.

tools.name: zaptec_get_installation
tools.description: Installation details: address, timezone, max and available current, load balancing, features, circuits, chargers.

tools.name: zaptec_get_charge_history
tools.description: Completed sessions in a time range with totals and optional cost.

tools.name: zaptec_pause_charging
tools.description: Pause the running charging session (changes state).

tools.name: zaptec_resume_charging
tools.description: Resume a paused charging session (changes state).

tools.name: zaptec_set_available_current
tools.description: Set or reset the installation's available current in amps (changes state, rate-guarded).

ZAPTEC_PRICE_PER_KWH.description: Electricity price; enables cost fields in the history tool

ZAPTEC_DEFAULT_CHARGER_ID.description: Charger to use when the account sees several

ZAPTEC_MIN_CURRENT_UPDATE_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between available-current changes; 0 disables the guard
